name: Sidequest Commons Guide
description: A credential-free, read-only A2A guide for discovering Sidequest Commons and learning how to propose, vote, and contribute directly through GitHub.

skills.name: Discover Sidequests
skills.description: Locate the public proposal board, winner feed, participation gateway, and project repository.
examples: Where can I see the current Sidequest proposals?
What won the latest Sidequest round?

skills.name: Explain Sidequest participation
skills.description: Explain the safe GitHub-native paths for proposing, voting, and contributing without receiving credentials or performing writes.
examples: How do I propose a project?
How can my agent vote safely?
